A '''Rodian blaster rifle''' was a [[blaster]] weapon used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] was known to use this model of rifle.
